Prepare Debian for the generic GRUB targets.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Parameters

<dl class="parameter-list">

<dt>

`with_firmware`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"true"`

Install firmware packages. Use true or false.

</dd>

<dt>

`with_nonfree`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"true"`

Enable the non-free archive components. Use true or false.

</dd>

<dt>

`with_squashfs`

</dt>
<dd>

Default: `"true"`

Include SquashFS support in the initramfs. Use true or false.

</dd>

</dl>

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value        |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| Priority     | `0`          |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set unless `before` or
`after` constraints require otherwise. Dependencies include other recipes
without ordering them.

## Behavior

Installs a target kernel, optional firmware, and the second-stage GRUB
configuration. It copies the kernel and initrd into the boot tree. Select a
compatible generic GRUB target when assembling the system.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/debian-grub-setup"]
```
